---
title: "LongViewSC Gene Report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    toc_depth: 2
    css: null
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: null
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{lscape}
params:
  gene: "Unknown"
  date: ""
  group_by: ""
  report_format: "html"
  selected_isoforms: NULL
  celltype_plot: NULL
  feature_plot_gene: NULL
  vln_plot: NULL
  isoform_plot: NULL
  dotplot_isoform: NULL
  transcript_plot: NULL
  pie_plot: NULL
  heatmap_plot: NULL
  trajectory_gene_plot: NULL
  trajectory_plot: NULL
  isoform_stats_df: NULL
  scatter_plot: NULL
  scatter_iso_x: ""
  scatter_iso_y: ""
  compare_feature_plot: NULL
  compare_gene_x: ""
  compare_gene_y: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  dpi     = 300,
  out.width = "100%"
)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
is_pdf <- isTRUE(params$report_format == "pdf")
if (is_pdf) { library(pheatmap) } else { library(DT); library(plotly) }
```

```{r html_style, results='asis', eval=!is_pdf}
cat('
<style>
  body { font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; }
  h1.title { color: #2c3e50; font-size: 2rem; }
  h2 { color: #2c3e50; border-bottom: 2px solid #18bc9c; padding-bottom: 6px; margin-top: 2rem; }
  h3 { color: #34495e; margin-top: 1.4rem; }
  .meta-box {
    background: #f8f9fa;
    border-left: 5px solid #18bc9c;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }
  .meta-box table { margin: 0; width: auto; }
  .meta-box td { padding: 3px 12px 3px 0; }
  .meta-box td:first-child { font-weight: 600; color: #555; white-space: nowrap; }
  .plot-note { color: #888; font-style: italic; font-size: 0.88rem; margin-top: 4px; }
  hr { border-top: 1px solid #e0e0e0; margin: 2rem 0; }
  .footer { color: #999; font-size: 0.82rem; text-align: center; margin-top: 3rem; padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #eee; }
</style>
')
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
iso_label <- if (length(params$selected_isoforms) > 0) {
  paste(sub("-[^-]+$", "", params$selected_isoforms), collapse = ", ")
} else {
  "none selected"
}

if (is_pdf) {
  cat(paste0(
    "**Gene:** ", params$gene, "  \n",
    "**Generated:** ", params$date, "  \n",
    "**Grouping variable:** ", params$group_by, "  \n",
    "**Selected isoforms:** ", iso_label, "\n\n",
    "---\n\n"
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste0(
    '<div class="meta-box"><table>',
    '<tr><td>Gene</td><td><strong>', params$gene, '</strong></td></tr>',
    '<tr><td>Generated</td><td>', params$date, '</td></tr>',
    '<tr><td>Grouping variable</td><td><code>', params$group_by, '</code></td></tr>',
    '<tr><td>Selected isoforms</td><td>', iso_label, '</td></tr>',
    '</table></div>'
  ))
}
```

## Isoform Statistics

```{r isoform_stats, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$isoform_stats_df)) {
  df  <- params$isoform_stats_df
  out <- data.frame(
    `Transcript ID`           = df$short_label,
    `Total Norm. Counts`      = round(df$total_expr, 1),
    `Raw Counts`              = ifelse(is.na(df$raw_counts), NA_integer_, df$raw_counts),
    `% Cells Expressing`      = df$pct_cells,
    `Cells (n)`               = df$num_cells,
    `Median Expr. (non-zero)` = df$median_expr,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (is_pdf) {
    out_pdf <- out
    names(out_pdf)[names(out_pdf) == "% Cells Expressing"] <- "Pct Cells Expressing"
    cat("\\newpage\n\\begin{landscape}\n")
    print(knitr::kable(out_pdf, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, escape = TRUE))
    cat("\\end{landscape}\n\\newpage\n")
  } else {
    DT::datatable(
      out,
      rownames = FALSE,
      options  = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(1, "desc"))),
      class    = "compact stripe hover"
    ) |>
      DT::formatStyle(
        "% Cells Expressing",
        background         = DT::styleColorBar(c(0, 100), "#c8e6c9"),
        backgroundSize     = "98% 70%",
        backgroundRepeat   = "no-repeat",
        backgroundPosition = "center"
      )
  }
} else {
  cat("No isoform statistics available.")
}
```

## Pseudobulk Heatmap

```{r heatmap_plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
if (!is.null(params$heatmap_plot)) {
  if (is_pdf) {
    # Re-compute a static pheatmap for PDF (plotly can't render in PDF)
    tryCatch({
      library(pheatmap)
      # Extract the data matrix from the plotly object
      mat_data <- params$heatmap_plot$x$data
      # Build matrix from plotly source data
      z    <- mat_data[[1]]$z
      rows <- mat_data[[1]]$y
      cols <- mat_data[[1]]$x
      if (!is.null(z) && !is.null(rows) && !is.null(cols)) {
        m <- matrix(as.numeric(z), nrow = length(rows), ncol = length(cols),
                    dimnames = list(rows, cols))
        # Strip -GENENAME suffix for cleaner row labels
        rownames(m) <- sub("-[^-]+$", "", rownames(m))
        pheatmap(m, cluster_cols = FALSE, fontsize = 11,
                 color = colorRampPalette(c("#f7fbff","#2171b5"))(50),
                 border_color = NA)
      } else {
        cat("*Heatmap data could not be extracted for PDF.*")
      }
    }, error = function(e) cat("*Heatmap not available in PDF.*"))
  } else if (inherits(params$heatmap_plot, "plotly")) {
    params$heatmap_plot
  } else {
    print(params$heatmap_plot)
  }
} else {
  cat("Not available — select at least 2 isoforms and press GO to generate.")
}
```

## Isoform Scatter

## Co-expression Feature Map

```{r compare_feature_plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
if (!is.null(params$compare_feature_plot)) {
  if (nzchar(params$compare_gene_x) && nzchar(params$compare_gene_y) &&
      !identical(params$compare_gene_x, params$compare_gene_y))
    cat(paste0("**Genes:** ", params$compare_gene_x, " vs ", params$compare_gene_y, "\n\n"))
  print(params$compare_feature_plot)
} else {
  cat("No co-expression feature map was generated in this session.")
}
```
